items.caption:
Mereka menang di kategori Fans' Choice Female Top10 dan Best Dance Performance Female Group.

Lagu utama mini album ke-4 mereka, 'It's Me', juga raih Best Song Top10.
Acaranya berlangsung pada 20-21 November di Kyocera Dome Osaka.

items.name: 02 🇺🇸 SEVENTEEN — 세븐틴 정한X조슈아, 日 6만2000 관객 동원․․․요코하마 추가 공연 확정
items.title: SEVENTEEN — 세븐틴 정한X조슈아, 日 6만2000 관객 동원...요코하마 추가 공연 확정
items.audio_start: 0:05 부근 (MV 시각 · 음원 인트로가 다르면 앞뒤로 맞추기)
items.caption:
About 62,000 fans attended their Saitama concerts over two days before the Yokohama shows were added.

JEONGHAN and JOSHUA performed their full mini album ‘DREAMSCAPE’ along with SEVENTEEN tracks during the Saitama shows. SEVENTEEN's JEONGHAN and JOSHUA will add two more concerts at Yokohama K-Arena on Jan 13-14, 2026.

The second day's show was relayed to 177 theaters worldwide, including in Korea, the US, and Singapore. A Japanese version of Love Letter.

The Saitama shows marked their first Japan stage in about 2 years and 6 months.

———

Source: Slist

items.name: 03 🇵🇹 ILLIT — 아일릿, ‘2026 MAMA’ 3관왕․․․눈부신 활약
items.title: ILLIT — 아일릿, ‘2026 MAMA’ 3관왕...눈부신 활약
items.caption:
O grupo venceu nas categorias Fans' Choice Female Top10 e Best Dance Performance Female Group.

A faixa-título do seu quarto mini-álbum, 'It's Me', também arrecadou o prémio Best Song Top10.
A cerimónia decorreu entre 20 e 21 de novembro, no Kyocera Dome Osaka.

As membros Minju, Iroha, Wonhee e Yunah subiram ao palco durante o evento.
O trabalho anterior do grupo, ' (You're Under Arrest)', já soma 41 284 006 visualizações, de acordo com a contagem de 24 de novembro de 2026.

ILLIT arrecadou três troféus nos 2026 MAMA AWARDS.
Os ILLIT estrearam-se em março de 2024.

———

Source: Sports Seoul

#KPOP #ILLIT #NoticiasKpop #KpopPortugal #MAMAAWARDS

08 🇮🇩 BTS — 방탄소년단, ‘26 MAMA’ 대상 2개 포함 5관.caption:
BTS meraih 5 trofi di 2026 MAMA AWARDS, termasuk Artist of the Year dan Album of the Year.

Grup ini juga memenangkan Best Song Top 10, Best Male Group, dan Fans' Choice. Kemenangan di kategori Artist of the Year ini jadi trofi ke-8 mereka di kategori tersebut.

Kemenangan ini membawa total Daesang (Grand Prize) BTS di MAMA menjadi 24. BTS nggak bisa hadir di acara ini karena jadwal world tour dan mengirimkan pesan video.

11 🇺🇸 BTS — 방탄소년단, ‘26 MAMA’ 대상 2개 포함 5관.caption:
BTS won five trophies at the 2026 MAMA AWARDS, including Artist of the Year and Album of the Year.

The group also took Best Song Top 10, Best Male Group, and Fans' Choice. This was their 8th Artist of the Year trophy, the most in the category.

The win brought BTS's total Daesang (Grand Prize) count at MAMA to 24. BTS could not attend the ceremony because of their world tour schedule and sent a video message instead.
